description: This file contains implementations for batching operations on tensors, specifically adding and removing batch dimensions in the context of batched tensor representations in PyTorch's ATen library. It defines functions like _add_batch_dim and _remove_batch_dim, which manipulate batch dimensions according to vmap levels.

methods.name: Tensor _add_batch_dim(const Tensor & self,int64_t batch_dim,int64_t level)
methods.description: Adds a batch dimension to a tensor at a specified level and dimension, returning a new tensor.

methods.name: bool has_level(const Tensor & self,int64_t level)
methods.description: Checks whether a tensor has a batch dimension at a specified vmap level.

methods.name: std::pair<Tensor,int64_t> remove_existing_batch_dim(const BatchedTensorImpl * batched,int64_t level)
methods.description: Removes a batch dimension at a specified level from a BatchedTensorImpl, returning the tensor without the batch dimension and its logical index.

methods.name: Tensor maybe_movedim(const Tensor & self,int64_t src,int64_t dst)
methods.description: Performs tensor dimension move operation; returns the original tensor if source and destination dims are the same.

methods.name: Tensor _remove_batch_dim(const Tensor & self,int64_t level,int64_t batch_size,int64_t out_dim)
methods.description: Removes a batch dimension at a specified level from a tensor, possibly adding one if it doesn't exist, and adjusts dimensions accordingly.
